verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a dedicated `humanlayer automation run` command for running a coding session from a CI job, a cron machine, or a server script. Launch tokens support non-interactive commands in shells without a PTY, and probe evidence confirms an official CLI. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI runs, and documented detail on CI integration (exit codes, output handling, CI-specific auth examples).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use `humanlayer automation run` to run one Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment — a CI job, a cron machine, or a script on a server.
Use a launch token for one non-interactive command. Examples include a shell without an interactive PTY and a one-time remote bootstrap script.
